question: A city has 40,000 street corners and 300 fire stations. For every corner you need the distance to the nearest station. What is the fastest plan?
options: One BFS that starts from all 300 stations at once
A BFS from every corner until it meets a station
A BFS from each station, keeping the minimum per corner
Sort the corners by distance to the city centre
explanation: Putting every station in the queue at distance 0 makes one search, and the first time a corner is reached is along a route from its nearest station: O(corners + streets) in total, instead of 300 or 40,000 separate searches.
